Name: Social Page Order Redux
Author: FlyingTNT
Description:
This is a combination of aedenthorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13698]Social Page Order Menu[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7871]Social Page Order Button[/url].

This mod adds a button and a dropdown menu that let you sort your relations in four ways:
[list=1]
[*]By hearts (ascending)
[*]By hearts (descending)
[*]By name (ascending)
[*]By name (descending)
[/list]
It also adds a search bar that allows you to search for specific characters, and buttons to hide gifted or talked NPCs.

[size=5]Config
[/size]You can configure the following using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing the config file:
[list]
[*]Keybinds for changing the sort option
[*]The positions of each of the components
[*]Enable/disable each of the components (button, dropdown, search bar, hide gifted/talked NPCs)
[/list]
[size=5]Technical[/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods[/url].
